name: MyNeS
description: MyNeS discovers, identifies and monitors every device on your home network, including the ones an IP scan cannot see. It speaks ARP, mDNS/Bonjour, SSDP/UPnP, Matter, Bluetooth LE and MQTT, so Zigbee2MQTT bulbs, Z-Wave JS sensors, BLE trackers and Tasmota nodes show up alongside your laptops and NAS. Vendor lookup over a 1000+ entry OUI database, topology and graph views, scan history, rule-based alerts by Web Push / webhook / e-mail, and two-way Home Assistant integration. Runs on the host network so ARP and mDNS/SSDP discovery actually work. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.
short_desc: Discover, identify and monitor every device on your LAN - Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, BLE and Matter.
author: fxerkan
